summary.text: The Travails was the catastrophe on Innistrad, tied to the fall of Avacyn, that broke the plane and left it with longer nights and more undead.

bio.text: In 2026 Tam reached an inn and learned from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.

status.text: The material's only event shows the Travails recounted as past history in September 2026, so the Travails is a past catastrophe.
